item.text: {"answer":{"pass":"intent","intent":{"stated":{"summary":"Let customers download plain-text receipts for their orders, with caching whose lifetime is configurable.","sources":[{"kind":"description","ref":null},{"kind":"ticket","ref":"SHOP-123"},{"kind":"commits","ref":null}]},"inferred":{"summary":"Adds an authenticated order-receipt endpoint that renders and caches plain-text receipts in process for a fixed hour.","behaviorChanges":["Customers can request a plain-text receipt for an order they own.","Receipt text is cached in process for one hour, regardless of configured cache settings.","The global rate limit increases from 60 to 600 requests per minute."]},"mismatches":[{"kind":"missing","description":"Receipt caching is hard-coded to one hour instead of using the configurable cache lifetime requested.","hunkIds":["h_2e2332fa455a2146","h_a2e0236601ffc778"]},{"kind":"unrequested","description":"Raises the global rate limit from 60 to 600 requests per minute, unrelated to receipt downloads.","hunkIds":["h_fbaf18305007c20a"]}]}}}
